goods.name: Logs
goods.description: Unprocessed timber used by the sample sawmill recipe.

goods.name: Planks
goods.description: Sawn timber produced by the sample sawmill recipe.

goods.name: Grain
goods.description: Harvested grain milled into flour for the food supply chain.

goods.name: Flour
goods.description: Milled grain used with timber fuel to bake bread.

goods.name: Bread
goods.description: Finished food baked from flour using logs as fuel.

goods.name: Furniture
goods.description: Finished household goods manufactured from sawn planks.

buildings.name: Sawmill
buildings.description: A building that can use the logs-to-planks recipe.

buildings.name: Lumber Camp
buildings.description: A resource-producing building that extracts logs without tradeable inputs.

buildings.name: Farm
buildings.description: A resource-producing building that harvests grain without tradeable inputs.

buildings.name: Mill
buildings.description: A building that processes grain into flour.

buildings.name: Bakery
buildings.description: A building that bakes flour into bread using logs as fuel.

buildings.name: Furniture Workshop
buildings.description: A building that manufactures furniture from planks.

recipes.name: Saw planks
recipes.description: Convert logs into planks in one sample production batch.

recipes.name: Harvest logs
recipes.description: Create two logs in one resource-extraction batch. Scheduling and stock limits belong to the scenario.

recipes.name: Harvest grain
recipes.description: Harvest four grain in one extraction batch. Scheduling and stock limits belong to the scenario.

recipes.name: Mill flour
recipes.description: Mill two grain into one flour.

recipes.name: Bake bread
recipes.description: Bake one flour into two bread, consuming one log as fuel.

recipes.name: Make furniture
recipes.description: Manufacture one furniture from two planks.

goods.name: Silver
goods.description: A physical precious metal extracted in v3 and shipped to the public Royal Mint. Surrendered Silver is retained in the monetary reserve.

buildings.name: Silver Mine
buildings.description: An eligible v3 extraction site producing Silver in complete batches, subject to actual payroll and storage limits.

buildings.name: Royal Mint
buildings.description: The unique public v3 institution commissioned by a company. It accepts physically delivered Silver into a reserve and issues bounded currency to the supplier and treasury. It is not a private factory or a Company Value asset.

recipes.name: Mine Silver
recipes.description: Extract one Silver in a complete batch. The scenario controls real wages, cadence, eligibility and output limits.
